title: Linearizability
description:
**SITUATION:**

You are still on the **Fleetline** dispatch team.

**What the dispatch service is.** Dispatch is Fleetline's backend for trips. It is not the map, not payments, and not the driver chat. It is the service that **owns trip state**: who requested the ride, which driver was matched, and what step the trip is on right now.

Trip **ownership** — which driver owns trip T — must behave as if there were one copy of the truth. Once a match is acknowledged, every subsequent read sees that owner until a later acknowledged change.

Two rider phones must not disagree about who owns T after a successful Match.

**YOUR TASK:**

Implement Lab 4.1 (`TODO(4.1)`).

1. A small replicated trip-owner register with linearizable `Match` / `ReadOwner`.
2. A history checker: client histories that violate linearizability fail.
3. Soft fields (ETA, location) stay out of this lab.

**SPEC:**

- Acknowledged Match then ReadOwner sees that driver
- Histories with two owners illegally fail
- Soft fields not part of the linearizable object
- Real-time order respected in the legal linearization

> **Note:** Graded Submit for this lab is not live yet. Use **Run** in the editor when verify commands exist; otherwise read the brief and explore the starter. The harness lands next.

hints: Once Match is acknowledged, later reads see that owner until a later ack'd change.
Real-time order: if A finishes before B starts, A precedes B.
Soft fields stay out of this lab.
Illegal two-owner histories must fail the checker.
problemStatement.overview: Trip ownership must behave as one copy of the truth.
problemStatement.brief: Provide a linearizable Match / ReadOwner for trip assignment.
